labelChirho: farmer, plowman, tiller of the soil
descriptionChirho: A masculine noun meaning farmer, plowman, or agricultural laborer — one who cultivates the land. All 7 occurrences carry the same lexical meaning with variation only in grammatical number and state: plural absolute (eng: farmers/plowmen, arb: فَلَّاحُونَ, kor: 농부들이, swa: wakulima), singular absolute (eng: farmer, arb: فَلَّاحًا, swa: mkulima, hin: किसान), and plural construct with suffix 'your farmers' (arb: فَلَّاحُوكُمْ, kor: 너희의–농부들과, swa: wakulima–wenu). Spanish consistently renders 'labrador(es)' and Hindi 'किसान' across all forms.
